observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a hand holding a flat, dark, square-ish plastic panel resting on floor tiles; no vents, no console ports, no PlayStation logo, buttons, or disc slot visible.
The object's shape and texture resemble a flat lid or cover (could be a laptop back panel, tablet case, or similar), not the recognizable rounded-edge, two-tone PS4 Slim console body.

Photo 2 shows a small rectangular box held in hand with regulatory markings (CE, WEEE) and a barcode, consistent with a smartphone or small electronics box, not the large distinctive PlayStation-branded console box.
No PlayStation logo, PS4 text, model number (CUH-22xx), ports, or power/eject buttons are visible in any photo.
Watermark 'OLASCOWORLDWIDE GADGETS' overlays all images; a faint 'POSTED ON [date]' stamp is visible but not legible.
